title: RemodelVision: make room constraints visible without calling a concept a guarantee
audience: Product, design, and applied-AI teams evaluating visual reasoning that respects a user's actual space.
promise: Show how an explicit room constraint could shape several renovation directions while keeping ownership, runtime proof, and estimate limits visible.
story: A synthetic original room fixture carries a plain brief: keep the floor, stay near a $12k budget, and prioritize storage.
Three concept directions make the tradeoff legible: warm minimal, color-forward, and storage-first.
The case keeps the input, preserved element, and budget-sensitive choices side by side instead of presenting an untraceable before/after.
The human remains the decision-maker: the fixture describes a concept and an estimate-oriented handoff, not a construction promise.
RV-1 contribution approval and RV-3 current-flow proof remain explicit gates; this packet does not replace either one.
verified_locally: The fixture is synthetic original work with no real property, people, address, geolocation, third-party asset, or provider output.
The brief, three directions, preserved-floor cue, and handoff limitation are represented in the local candidate materials.
The contribution ledger and runtime receipt remain linked as blockers rather than being collapsed into a polished product claim.
The local packet includes a candidate no-auth source page, short copy, claim ledger, and reviewed 1600x900 binary.
open_gates: Obtain the explicit owner and collaborator approval required by RV-1 before publishing a personal or team case study.
Return to RV-3 with approved disposable runtime configuration or a repository-owned no-key demo path and direct-surface access.
Prove constraint adherence and bounded estimate assumptions from a current product run after RV-3 closes.
Verify a hosted no-auth case URL and read back each external destination before release.
claim_boundary: This packet proves rights-safe material preparation and a traceable synthetic concept target. It does not claim RemodelVision's live upload, generation, vision analysis, estimate, persistence, handoff, contribution approval, hosting, or publication.
